The '''Dakshee Holocron''' was a metallic pyramid-shaped [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that dated from the period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. It emitted a faint hum that facilitated the blocking out of distractions, and allowed Jedi to focus and attune themselves to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was in the possession of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Djinn Kylo]].<ref name="Game" />
